Path 2: Official model.sample_actions() with same preprocessed inputs torch.manual_seed(123) raw_actions = wrapper.model.sample_actions(imgs, img_masks, lt, lm) print(f\\\"Official raw: shape={raw_actions.shape}\\\", flush=True) print(f\\\"  mean={raw_actions.mean():.6f}, std={raw_actions.std():.6f}\\\", flush=True)  # Unnormalize to compare from utils import FULL_ACTION_DIM raw_7d = raw_actions[:, :, :FULL_ACTION_DIM] unnorm = raw_7d * wrapper.action_std[:FULL_ACTION_DIM] + wrapper.action_mean[:FULL_ACTION_DIM] print(f\\\"Official unnorm action[0,:5]={unnorm[0,0,:5].cpu().numpy()}\\\", flush=True)  # Compare diff = (samples_wrapper[0,0] - unnorm[0]).abs().mean().item() print(f\\\"Mean abs diff: {diff:.6f}\\\", flush=True)  print(f\\\"[{time.time()-t0:.1f}s] DONE\\\", flush=True) EOF cd /root/acr-vla-conformal-refinement && nohup env CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 python -u /tmp/compare_paths.py > /tmp/compare_paths.log 2>&1 & echo \\\"PID=$!\\\"\\nroot     848217  310  0.6 22587996 3321256 ?    Rl   14:58   3:53 python -u /tmp/compare_paths.py\\n\", \"stderr\": \"\", \"return_code\": 0}, \"error\": null, \"metadata\": {\"elapsed_seconds\": 0.32}}"}}}
